slug: 2025-12-22 Smart Paper Technology is Transforming Community Health Data Capture in The Gambia

systems.platform: Smart Paper Technology (Shifo Foundation), synchronised with DHIS2
systems.owner: Ministry of Health with MRCG at LSHTM, Shifo Foundation, US CDC and Bundung Hospital
systems.tiers: launched 2017, piloted at Bundung Maternal and Child Hospital and Fajikunda

note: The only system described is Smart Paper Technology, a patient-level maternal, child and immunisation record on scanned paper forms (class tracker), so no hmis or emr fact; DHIS2 is named only as what SPT synchronises with, and the statement that facilities relied on paper registers for decades is undated.
